{"report": "# Maple Records Team Decision Note

## Option Comparison

All options are on-premises (S1, S2). Current storage need is 12 TB; 4 TB growth is a forecast, not a current requirement (S1).

| Option | First-year cost | Recovery | Capacity |
|--------|----------------|----------|----------|
| A | 8 + 3 = 11 units | 2 hrs | 24 TB |
| B | 5 + 3 = 8 units | 5 hrs | 24 TB |
| C | 6 + 2 = 8 units | 3 hrs | 14 TB |

## Assessment

A exceeds the 10-unit budget (S1, S2). B fails the 4-hour recovery limit (S1, S2). Only C meets budget, recovery, and current capacity (S2).

## Recommendation

Adopt C as the only currently feasible option (S1, S2).

## Pre-growth Check

Before storage exceeds 14 TB, confirm C expansion price and post-expansion recovery time, which are currently unknown (S2).", "notes": "Word count: ~130 words. Counted headings, table cells, and citations as whitespace-separated words. Table formatting kept minimal. No preference weights or exceptions invented. Current constraints (budget, recovery, 12 TB) distinguished from forecast (4 TB growth). Next step stated per brief. Review: meets 120–170 word target, cites S1/S2, recommends feasible option, identifies pre-growth check."}
